title: Gap1 plugin-link rule: shared impl or mirrored copies (bootstrap.ts vs plugin-session-start.mjs)
context: bootstrap.ts (TypeScript, compiled to dist) must gain the same 'never take over a working npm link; only fill a missing/dangling link and point it at CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/runtime when running as a plugin' rule that plugin-session-start.mjs already implements in repointFrameworkLink(). The .mjs runtime hooks are deliberately dist-less and dependency-free (they run before dist resolves); the TS path runs from compiled dist. bootstrap.ts already mirrors small helpers from the hook (symlinkType, frameworkHome).

options.label: Mirror the rule in both files (add a plugin-aware branch to bootstrap.ts), add a consistency test asserting they agree
Extract the rule into one shared .mjs module imported by both the hook and the TS at runtime
Single TS source of truth; generate/copy the .mjs at build time

rationale: The .mjs runtime hooks are dist-less and cannot import compiled TS; mirror matches the existing TS/.mjs duplication pattern. Add a consistency test.
